moments.title: World Cup 2026 Aftermath
moments.blurb: Spain beat defending champions Argentina 1-0 in the FIFA World Cup 2026 final held on July 19 in New York/New Jersey, marking Spain's second title win.

angles.name: Spain's Victory
angles.copy: Still buzzing from the World Cup final? Spain made history last week, clinching their second title after a tense 1-0 victory over Argentina! Where were you watching?

angles.copy: The FIFA World Cup 2026 has wrapped! From the opening game on June 11 to Spain lifting the trophy on July 19, what was your favourite moment of the tournament?

moments.title: Mick Jagger Turns 83
moments.blurb: Sir Mick Jagger, the iconic frontman of The Rolling Stones, celebrates his 83rd birthday today, July 26, 2026.

angles.name: Rock Legend Birthday

angles.name: Enduring Icon
angles.copy: 83 years young and still the definition of a rockstar. Happy Birthday to the one and only Mick Jagger! An absolute icon of music.

angles.name: Festival Wrap Up
angles.copy: That's a wrap for Latitude Festival 2026! What an incredible weekend in Henham Park with Lewis Capaldi, David Byrne, Teddy Swims and so many more. Who did you catch?

angles.name: Best Moments

angles.name: Prog Rock Icon
